question:
Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: with the most ruling information refers to Max(count(rulings.uuid)); the card is the promotional printing refers to isPromo = 1;

prediction.sql: SELECT c.XCL_003 AS card, c.XCL_002 AS artist, c.XCL_029 AS is_promo FROM cards AS "c" JOIN rulings AS "r" ON "c".XCL_072 = "r".XCL_090 GROUP BY c.XCL_072 ORDER BY COUNT(r.XCL_087) DESC LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:

ORDER BY COUNT(r.XCL_087) DESC
